name: Tamu Bay Resort & Kitchen
description: A 42-room beachfront boutique resort on Diani Beach with an open-air Swahili-fusion restaurant, infinity pool and spa. Fictional demo business used to showcase the FaidaHQ Hospitality Assistant.

branding.welcome_message: Jambo! I'm Amani, Tamu Bay's virtual concierge. Ask me about rooms, our menu, the spa or making a reservation.

ai_settings.tone: warm, welcoming and concise, like a Kenyan coastal concierge
ai_settings.extra_instructions: Use a light Swahili greeting (Jambo, Karibu, Asante) where natural. Prices are in Kenyan Shillings (KES).

knowledge.title: Reception
knowledge.content: Open 24 hours, every day.

knowledge.title: Check-in and check-out
knowledge.content: Check-in from 2:00 pm. Check-out by 11:00 am. Late check-out until 3:00 pm can be requested and depends on availability (KES 4,000).

knowledge.title: Pwani Restaurant
knowledge.content: Breakfast 6:30 am to 10:30 am. Lunch 12:30 pm to 3:30 pm. Dinner 7:00 pm to 10:30 pm. Open every day, including public holidays.

knowledge.title: Mvua Spa
knowledge.content: 9:00 am to 8:00 pm daily. Last treatment starts at 7:00 pm.

knowledge.title: Pool and beach bar
knowledge.content: Infinity pool 7:00 am to 8:00 pm. Beach bar 10:00 am to 11:00 pm.

knowledge.title: Garden Room
knowledge.content: 28 m², queen bed, garden view, air conditioning, rain shower, free Wi-Fi. Sleeps up to 2 adults.

knowledge.title: Ocean View Room
knowledge.content: 34 m², king or twin beds, private balcony facing the Indian Ocean, air conditioning, minibar. Sleeps up to 2 adults and 1 child under 12.

knowledge.title: Family Suite
knowledge.content: 62 m², two bedrooms (king + twin), living area, garden terrace, two bathrooms. Sleeps up to 4 adults or 2 adults and 3 children.

knowledge.title: Beachfront Villa
knowledge.content: 110 m², private plunge pool, direct beach access, outdoor shower, butler service. Sleeps up to 2 adults.

knowledge.title: Infinity pool
knowledge.content: Heated infinity pool overlooking the ocean, with a separate shallow children's pool. Towels provided.

knowledge.title: Mvua Spa
knowledge.content: Four treatment rooms, steam room and couples' suite. Signature 60-minute Swahili coconut massage.

knowledge.title: Wi-Fi and workspace
knowledge.content: Free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the resort and a quiet co-working lounge by the lobby.

knowledge.title: Parking
knowledge.content: Free secure parking for guests, with 24-hour security.

knowledge.title: Kids' club
knowledge.content: Supervised kids' club for ages 4 to 12, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Free for staying guests.

knowledge.title: Airport transfer
knowledge.content: Private transfer from Ukunda Airstrip (10 minutes) or Moi International Airport, Mombasa (about 1 hour 30 minutes).
knowledge.price_unit: one way from Mombasa, up to 4 people

knowledge.title: Swahili coconut massage
knowledge.content: 60-minute full-body massage with warm coconut oil.

knowledge.title: Snorkelling trip to Kisite Marine Park
knowledge.content: Full-day dhow trip with snorkelling gear, seafood lunch and park fees. Runs Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday.

knowledge.title: Laundry
knowledge.content: Same-day laundry if handed in before 10:00 am. Priced per item; see the list in your room.

knowledge.title: Swahili breakfast
knowledge.content: Mandazi, chai masala, tropical fruit, eggs any style. Included in all room rates.

knowledge.title: Grilled catch of the day
knowledge.content: Fresh reef fish with coconut rice, kachumbari and tamarind sauce.

knowledge.title: Prawn pilau
knowledge.content: Spiced Lamu-style pilau with king prawns and raita.

knowledge.title: Coconut bean curry (vegan)
knowledge.content: Red kidney beans in coconut curry with chapati or rice. Vegan and gluten-free on request.

knowledge.title: Nyama choma platter
knowledge.content: Charcoal-grilled goat ribs with ugali, sukuma wiki and kachumbari. Serves 2.

knowledge.title: Mango and passion sorbet
knowledge.content: House-made, dairy-free.

knowledge.title: Dawa cocktail
knowledge.content: Vodka, lime, honey and crushed ice. Non-alcoholic version available.

knowledge.title: Cancellation policy
knowledge.content: Free cancellation up to 7 days before arrival. Cancellations within 7 days are charged one night. No-shows are charged the full stay.

knowledge.title: Deposit
knowledge.content: A 30% deposit by M-Pesa or card is needed to secure a room booking once the reservation team confirms availability.

knowledge.title: Children
knowledge.content: Children under 4 stay free in their parents' room. Children 4 to 11 sharing with parents pay KES 3,500 per night including breakfast.

knowledge.title: Pets
knowledge.content: Pets are not allowed, except registered assistance animals.

knowledge.title: Restaurant reservations
knowledge.content: Table bookings are recommended for dinner. Groups larger than 10 must be arranged with the restaurant manager. Tables are held for 15 minutes.

knowledge.title: Payment methods
knowledge.content: M-Pesa, Visa, Mastercard and cash (KES, USD, EUR).

knowledge.title: Stay 4, pay 3
knowledge.content: Book 4 nights in any room type and the 4th night is free. Valid for stays from 1 February to 31 March 2027. Not combinable with other offers.

knowledge.title: Sunset seafood night
knowledge.content: Every Friday from 7:00 pm: seafood buffet with live taarab music on the beach.

knowledge.title: Is breakfast included?
knowledge.content: Yes. All room rates include breakfast at Pwani Restaurant. The Beachfront Villa includes breakfast and dinner.

knowledge.title: Do you accept walk-in diners?
knowledge.content: Yes, non-residents are welcome at Pwani Restaurant. Booking ahead for dinner is recommended, especially on Fridays.

knowledge.title: How far is the resort from the airport?
knowledge.content: 10 minutes from Ukunda Airstrip and about 1 hour 30 minutes from Moi International Airport in Mombasa, depending on the Likoni ferry.

knowledge.title: Can you cater for dietary needs?
knowledge.content: Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, halal and gluten-free meals are available. Please mention allergies when booking.
